title: Sharp 44% increase in Rotterdam area car break-ins, despite national decline
title_zh: 尽管全国范围内汽车盗窃案数量有所下降，但鹿特丹地区的汽车盗窃案却急剧增加了44%。
description: Break-ins and thefts from passenger cars jumped 44 percent in the Rotterdam region in the first nine months of 2026, rising from 3,871 to 5,590.
description_zh: 2026 年前九个月，鹿特丹地区的乘用车盗窃案增加了 44%，从 3,871 起增加到 5,590 起。

title: EasyJet continually fights customer compensation claims despite losing 50 cases: Report
title_zh: 据报道，尽管输掉了50起客户赔偿诉讼，易捷航空仍持续抗辩客户索赔。
description: British low-cost airline easyJet is engaged in ongoing legal battles against travelers seeking compensation for cancelled flights.
description_zh: 英国廉价航空公司易捷航空正与寻求航班取消赔偿的旅客进行持续的法律诉讼。

title: Dutch homebuyers' confidence falls to lowest level since early 2024
title_zh: 荷兰购房者信心跌至2024年初以来的最低水平
description: Confidence in the Dutch owner-occupied housing market sank in October to its lowest point since January 2024.
description_zh: 10 月份，荷兰自住房屋市场的信心跌至 2024 年 1 月以来的最低点。

title: Man admits role in failed assassination attempt on Iranian activist in Haarlem

description: A 40-year-old suspect admitted on Friday that he had traveled to the Netherlands to carry out an attempted contract killing on Iranian activist and writer Siamak Tadayon Tahmasbi in Haarlem on June
description_zh: 一名40岁的嫌疑人周五承认，他曾前往荷兰，企图于6月在哈勒姆谋杀伊朗活动家兼作家西亚马克·塔达永·塔赫马斯比。

title: ASML to give €100 million to Eindhoven Rijksmuseum branch
title_zh: ASML 将向埃因霍温国立博物馆分馆捐赠 1 亿欧元
description: ASML will contribute 100 million euros over 20 years to the future Rijksmuseum branch in Eindhoven. The municipality and the semiconductor equipment maker have formalized the agreement.
description_zh: ASML将在20年内向位于埃因霍温的荷兰国家博物馆分馆捐赠1亿欧元。市政府和这家半导体设备制造商已正式签署了这项协议。

title: Interior minister backs plan to ban politicians from holding multiple political roles
title_zh: 内政部长支持禁止政治人物兼任多个政治职务的计划
description: Interior Minister Pieter Heerma has expressed support for a plan by D66 and PRO to prohibit politicians from holding certain public offices simultaneously.
description_zh: 内政部长彼得·赫尔马表示支持D66和PRO提出的禁止政治人物同时担任某些公职的计划。

title: ING bank launches €128.5 million loan program for Dutch small and mid-sized businesses
title_zh: 荷兰国际集团（ING）推出一项面向荷兰中小企业的1.285亿欧元贷款计划
description: ING and the European Investment Fund (EIF)
description_zh: 荷兰国际集团和欧洲投资基金（EIF）

title: Elderly people also vulnerable to RS virus; Doctors call for vaccinations
title_zh: 老年人也易感染呼吸道合胞病毒；医生呼吁接种疫苗
description: The respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), commonly associated with serious infections in babies and young children, also poses a significant health risk to older people, particularly those with chroni
description_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）通常与婴幼儿的严重感染有关，同时也对老年人，特别是慢性病患者，构成重大健康风险。

title: Swedish teenager convicted for shooting outside Alphen aan den Rijn prison
title_zh: 瑞典青少年因在莱茵河畔阿尔芬监狱外开枪而被定罪
description: A boy has been convicted in Sweden for the attempted shooting of a manoutside the
description_zh: 瑞典一名男孩因在户外试图枪击一名男子而被定罪。

title: Dutch Cabinet wants to give working refugees more time to integrate
title_zh: 荷兰政府内阁希望给予从事工作的难民更多时间融入社会。
description: The Dutch government intends to grant working refugees more time to complete their civic integration requirements, Minister Thierry Aartsen of Work and Participation informed parliament.
description_zh: 荷兰政府打算给予工作难民更多时间来完成其公民融入要求，就业与参与事务部长蒂埃里·阿尔岑向议会通报了这一消息。

title: Hacked freezers, bomb threats on flights: Russia ramping up hybrid warfare, experts say
title_zh: 专家称，俄罗斯正在加紧混合战争，包括入侵冷冻柜和飞机炸弹威胁。

title: Dutch parliament backs small nuclear power plants to reduce dependence on non-EU energy
title_zh: 荷兰议会支持建设小型核电站，以减少对非欧盟能源的依赖
description: A majority in parliament supports proposals from coalition parties D66 and VVD to accelerate the construction of small-scale nuclear power plants in the Netherlands.
description_zh: 议会多数议员支持执政联盟政党D66和VVD提出的加快在荷兰建设小型核电站的提案。

title: More bomb threats reported at Prague Airport, including flight to Netherlands
title_zh: 布拉格机场再次接到炸弹威胁报告，其中包括飞往荷兰的航班。
description: More bomb threats were reported on flights leaving Václav Havel Airport in Prague on Friday morning, with one of the flights involved having landed in the Netherlands.
description_zh: 周五上午，从布拉格瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔机场起飞的航班再次接到炸弹威胁报告，其中一架涉事航班已降落在荷兰。

title: Protesters break onto site of planned Microsoft data center in A'dam; Police intervene
title_zh: 抗议者闯入微软在阿姆斯特丹的数据中心建设工地；警方介入
description: Dozens of protesters have climbed over or through the fence surrounding thesite in
description_zh: 数十名抗议者翻越或穿过了场地周围的围栏。

title: EU plan obliges Netherlands to take in asylum seekers or provide financial support
title_zh: 欧盟计划要求荷兰接收寻求庇护者或提供财政支持
description: The Netherlands will also have to take in asylum seekers from other EU countries next year.
description_zh: 明年，荷兰还将不得不接收来自其他欧盟国家的寻求庇护者。

title: Zeist to house up to 100 people on historic estate for 2.5 years amid housing shortage
title_zh: 泽斯特庄园将在住房短缺的情况下，利用其历史悠久的庄园安置多达100人，为期两年半。
description: The municipality of Zeist will temporarily house up to 100 people seeking homes on a historic 1908 estate in the Dichtersbuurt neighborhood.
description_zh: 泽斯特市政府将暂时安置多达 100 名在迪希特斯布尔特社区一处建于 1908 年的历史庄园内寻求住房的人。

title: Bruna owner Audax granted court protection amid financial crisis
title_zh: Bruna 的所有者 Audax 在金融危机中获得法院保护
description: Audax, which owns the Dutch bookstore chain Bruna, is struggling financially and has been granted temporary protection from creditors by the court in Breda.
description_zh: 拥有荷兰连锁书店 Bruna 的 Audax 公司目前财务状况不佳，布雷达法院已给予其暂时的债权人保护。

title: Dutch security agency urges businesses to prepare for faster AI-driven cyberattacks

description_zh: 荷兰国家安全与反恐协调员（NCTV）警告称，黑客正越来越多地利用人工智能来更快、更大规模、更高效地发动网络攻击。

title: Cabinet sets out AI plan, seeks partners beyond US and China
title_zh: 内阁制定人工智能计划，寻求美国和中国以外的合作伙伴。

description_zh: 荷兰部分地区，包括布拉班特省、林堡省等地，一夜之间气温降至冰点以下，已经出现了第一场霜冻。

title: Verwey-Jonker Institute facing bankruptcy amid AI rise

title: Five of seven Dutch reptile species in decline, CBS says
title_zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司称，荷兰七种爬行动物中有五种数量正在减少。

title: Nearly 17 percent of homes now selling below asking price
title_zh: 目前近17%的房屋售价低于要价。

description_zh: Huispedia周四在一份新闻稿中报道，由于房屋卖不出去，越来越多的卖家不得不降低要价。

title: KLM flight grounded by bomb threat canceled due to technical fault

title_zh: 近80%的房屋租赁中介会配合房东的歧视性要求。

description_zh: 近 80% 的房屋租赁经纪人愿意应房东的要求在住房市场进行歧视。

title: First frost of the season recorded in three provinces; Chilly weekend ahead
title_zh: 三个省份出现今冬首场霜冻；周末天气寒冷
description: Temperatures dropped below freezing in Noord-Brabant, Limburg, and parts of Zeeland overnight, marking the first local frost of the season, Weeronline reported.

title: Ajax, NEC and Twente win in Europe as AZ lose to Juventus

description: Three of the four Dutch clubs playing in Europe on Thursday night won, broadcaster NOS reported. Only AZ Alkmaar lost...
description_zh: 据荷兰广播公司NOS报道，周四晚参加欧战的四支荷兰俱乐部中有三支获胜，只有阿尔克马尔输球……

title: AZ lose to Juventus as 17-match unbeaten European home run ends
title_zh: 阿尔克马尔不敌尤文图斯，欧战主场17场不败纪录终结。

description_zh: 周四，AZ在欧联杯比赛中惜败于尤文图斯。

title: KLM flight from Amsterdam to Bucharest & Tel Aviv targeted in bomb threat
title_zh: 一架从阿姆斯特丹飞往布加勒斯特和特拉维夫的荷航航班遭遇炸弹威胁
description: A KLM flight on its way to Tel Aviv by way of a scheduled stopover in Bucharest was one of many passenger flights targeted by a bomb threat on Thursday.

title: Twente come from behind to beat Pafos and maintain perfect European record
title_zh: 特温特逆转战胜帕福斯，保持了在欧洲赛场上的完美战绩。

description_zh: 周四，在欧足联联盟联赛中，特温特队逆转战胜帕福斯队，比分为 3-1。

description_zh: 五名男子因涉嫌试图通过艾默伊登港向荷兰走私可卡因而被捕。

title: Ajax thrash Danish side Midtjylland 6-1 after second-half goal rush in Conference League

description: Ajax notched up an impressive 6-1 win away to Danish side FC Midtjylland in the UEFA Conference League on Thursday.
description_zh: 周四，阿贾克斯在欧足联联盟联赛中客场以 6-1 大胜丹麦球队中日德兰。

title: NEC fight back to beat Omonia Nicosia and claim second UEFA Europa League win

description: NEC picked up their second UEFA Europa League win in a row on Thursday.
description_zh: NEC周四取得了他们在欧足联欧洲联赛中的第二场连胜。

title: Video: AI gives face to unidentified Dutch girl 36 years after she was tortured, killed

title: Video: 15 graffiti sprayers coat Amsterdam metro in paint, trap passengers inside

description_zh: 据阿姆斯特丹市政府称，10月31日，约20名涂鸦者在阿姆斯特丹一列载有乘客的地铁上制造混乱，他们将一辆自行车扔到轨道上，并在几分钟内将整列火车涂满了油漆。

title: Two more people die from West Nile virus as Dutch cases reach 77
title_zh: 荷兰新增两例西尼罗河病毒死亡病例，确诊病例达77例。
description: Two more people have died from West Nile virus infections, bringing the number of reported fatalities in the Netherlands to 12.
description_zh: 荷兰又有两人死于西尼罗河病毒感染，使该国报告的死亡人数达到 12 人。

title: KLM unions fear job losses and worsening working conditions under new plans

description: Trade union CNV has expressed serious concerns about KLM's planned cost-cutting measures, warning that they could have a major impact on employees.

title: Airlines scrap Eindhoven flights over Thursday evening air traffic controller shortage
